title: LFQA-HP-1M: A Large-Scale Human Preference Dataset for Long-Form Question Answering
authors_zh: Rafid Ishrak Jahan、Fahmid Shahriar Iqbal、Sagnik Ray Choudhury（University of North Texas）
paper_type_zh: 长篇问答人工偏好数据集、量规评测与 LLM 裁判审计
best_for_zh: 需要构建或审计长篇问答奖励模型、两两偏好评测器、LLM-as-a-Judge，且能严格追溯上游公开数据许可与污染风险的研究者。
one_line: LFQA-HP-1M filters and unifies 1,326,356 public human preference pairs for English long-form QA, then uses nine rubrics to audit interpretable and LLM-based judges.
LFQA-HP-1M 从公开偏好来源筛选并统一 1,326,356 条英语长篇问答人工两两偏好记录，并以九维质量量规审计可解释模型和 LLM 裁判。
why: It makes long-form QA preference feedback reusable as a traceable data object while demonstrating that a transparent rubric model can approach strong LLM judges and that those judges remain vulnerable to consistency, position, length, and perturbation failures.
inclusion_reason: Public, large-scale, human pairwise preference data for long-form QA, with explicit source lineage, record schema, rubric-based evaluation, and judge-robustness analysis.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Long-form QA preferences are scattered across community and evaluation sources, and many records are not genuinely explanatory multi-sentence questions. LFQA-HP-1M asks how to isolate a traceable long-form subset without relabeling existing human choices.

It filters and standardizes upstream pairwise judgments into a long-form QA resource and evaluates how rubric-based and LLM judges handle those comparisons.

长篇问答偏好分散在社区和评测来源中，许多记录并非真正需要多句解释的问题。LFQA-HP-1M 讨论如何在不重新标注既有人类选择的前提下，筛出可追溯的长篇问答子集。

它过滤并标准化上游成对判断，形成长篇问答资源，再评估基于量表和语言模型的裁判如何处理这些比较。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: LFQA-HP-1M retains human pairwise choices from SHP-2, LFQA Eval, and Chatbot Arena after a high-confidence long-form-question filter. It releases 1,326,356 records from about 900K source prompts; each record includes question text, two answers, a human judgment, expertise flag, domain, language, turn, and source. The feedback contract remains the original human comparison, not the later nine-rubric evaluation features.
LFQA-HP-1M 经高置信度长篇问题过滤后，保留 SHP-2、LFQA Eval 和 Chatbot Arena 的人工成对选择。它发布 1,326,356 条记录，来自约 900K 个源提示；每条含问题文本、两个回答、人类判断、专业性标记、领域、语言、轮次和来源。反馈契约仍是原始人工比较，而非后续九量表评测特征。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Aggregate upstream public preference records. 2. Iteratively define long-form questions with five English-proficient annotators, then use Llama-4-Scout in batches of ten to retain only 100%-confidence LFQ predictions. 3. Map retained prompts back to answer pairs and standardize record fields. 4. On a sampled set, extract nine rubric scores and compare logistic-regression and LLM judges; these scores evaluate judges and do not replace human labels.

The release is English-only and research-use terms require checking upstream licenses. Fix upstream revisions, LFQ prompt, Llama-4 version, and deduplication policy for reproduction.

1. 汇集上游公开偏好记录。2. 由五名英语熟练标注者迭代定义长篇问题，再用 Llama-4-Scout 每批十条地过滤，只保留置信度为百分之百的预测。3. 将保留提示映射回回答对，并标准化记录字段。4. 在抽样集合上提取九项量表分数，比较逻辑回归和语言模型裁判；这些分数用于评估裁判，不替代人工标签。

发布仅含英语，研究用途条款和上游许可均须核验。复现需固定上游版本、长篇问题提示、Llama-4 版本和去重政策。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Claim: a large, traceable long-form preference corpus exposes limits of judge models. The paper reports 1,326,356 retained pairs and uses LFQA-HP-Sample to compare nine-rubric logistic regression with prompted LLM judges. It reports position sensitivity, verbosity bias, transitivity violations, and degradation under TextFooler or DeepWordBug. These results diagnose those evaluated judges and perturbations, not factual correctness of every pair.
主张：大规模且可追溯的长篇偏好语料揭示裁判模型的局限。论文报告保留 1,326,356 个回答对，并以 LFQA-HP-Sample 比较九量表逻辑回归与提示式语言模型裁判。报告发现位置敏感、篇幅偏差、传递性违反，以及在 TextFooler 或 DeepWordBug 下性能下降。这些结果诊断所评裁判和扰动，不证明每个回答对的事实正确性。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Closest resources retain broad community preferences without operationally restricting question form. LFQA-HP-1M changes the data object by filtering for long-form questions and preserving source lineage and expertise fields; it does not collect a new million human judgments.
最接近的资源保留宽泛社区偏好，却不以操作化定义限制问题形式。LFQA-HP-1M 通过过滤长篇问题并保留来源谱系和专业性字段改变数据对象；它并未重新收集一百万条人工判断。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Author-stated limitation: high-confidence LLM filtering can exclude legitimate borderline long-form questions; audit retained and rejected prompts around the boundary. Curator risk: the corpus is English-only and overwhelmingly non-expert, so do not generalize its choices to multilingual or expert QA without stratified evaluation.
作者所述局限：高置信度语言模型过滤会排除处于边界但合理的长篇问题；应审计边界附近的保留与拒绝提示。策展风险：语料仅含英语且绝大多数不是专家标注，未做分层评估时不能把选择推广到多语种或专家问答。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it to train or audit a long-form QA reward model with the provided source and expertise fields, then test on held-out sources or a seed-disjoint split. Success is pairwise agreement plus robustness to position and verbosity perturbations. Do not use the nine rubric scores as replacement training labels or assume upstream licenses are permissive.
可用它按来源和专业性字段训练或审计长篇问答奖励模型，再在留出来源或种子不重叠划分上测试。成功标准是成对一致率以及对位置和篇幅扰动的稳健性。九项量表分数不能被当作替代训练标签，也不能假定上游许可宽松。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. The corpus filters existing human pairs; it does not recollect one million judgments.
  2. Llama-4-Scout retains only 100%-confidence long-form-question predictions.
  3. It has 1,326,356 English records with source and expertise fields.
  4. Judge audits reveal position, length, transitivity, and perturbation failures.
  5. Audit source overlap and upstream licenses before training.

1. 该语料过滤既有人类回答对，并未重收一百万条判断。
  2. Llama-4-Scout 只保留置信度百分之百的长篇问题预测。
  3. 它有 1,326,356 条英语记录，并保留来源和专业性字段。
  4. 裁判审计发现位置、长度、传递性和扰动失效。
  5. 训练前应审计来源重叠和上游许可。
